1) SOC 2 evidence (latest report + scoped controls) — needed by 2026-06-14 for our security gating team.
2) Procurement: PO issuance or legal ok for LTD terms by 2026-06-20.
3) Exec approval: confirm David Liu as final signatory and include legal contact (name + email).
4) Integration kickoff slot: we plan a 2-week ramp; proposed start date July 1 works if signatures are complete by 6/24.

If SOC2 will be delayed, we can still do a conditional canary deployment for a short eval, but production SLA and data retention terms require the SOC2 scope. Can you confirm who on your side will own these artifacts?

I'll loop in Monica from Sales Ops if we need to accelerate contracting.
